title: RMOS-AUTHORITY-MAP-001: Stage 1 census + Stage 2 classification (not an agent)
intent: One-off RMOS audit: Stage 1 capability model plus Stage 2 deep classification after owner taxonomy acceptance. Adds surface_kind (manufacturing vs transformation vs retrieval vs advisory), populates dispositions from static traces and safe TestClient witnesses, MAR-009–020. Grounding Agent v0.1 remains the only agent under trial. No new agent. No production CAM/RMOS/feasibility/route/client/persistence/G-code behavior change. No remediation in this tranche.

diff_articulation.what_changed: Extends the Stage-1 census with the owner-required surface_kind boundary, a Stage-2 overlay (scripts/audit/rmos_authority_stage2.py), populated manufacturing_authority_registry.json dispositions, MAR-009–020 tests with ephemeral-store witnesses, and an updated audit report. Acoustic binding is grouped under binding. Nothing production-facing imports the registry. No CAM/RMOS production modules changed. No new agent.
diff_articulation.why_not_redundant: Existing RMOS audits and live_routes.json are route censuses and historical leads. There is no capability-level manufacturing reachability registry, and adjacent maps (CANONICAL_AUTHORITY_MAP, geometry_authority_registry, ontology_authority_map) explicitly do not own machine-output authority. This increment is the evidence artifact a later cutover would consume; it introduces no runtime authority.
